name: Fake React Chat
description: An AI-powered fake stream chat that reacts to your gameplay.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the chat while playing levels.

api-key.name: Claude API Key
api-key.description: Your Anthropic API key (starts with <cy>sk-ant-</c>). Get one at console.anthropic.com. It is only sent to api.anthropic.com.

model.name: Model
model.description: Claude model ID. Haiku is fast and cheap.

chatters.name: Chatters
chatters.description: How many different people are in chat.

activity.name: Chat Activity
activity.description: How fast chat moves. Faster = more API calls (still cheap).

toxicity.name: Chat Vibe
toxicity.description: Wholesome = supportive. Normal = typical GD chat banter. Spicy = roasts you harder (never hateful).

max-calls-per-minute.name: Max AI Calls / Minute
max-calls-per-minute.description: Hard cap on API calls, to keep costs predictable.

chat-width.name: Chat Width
chat-width.description: Width of the chat box (fraction of the screen).
